mapper.select: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (owner_user_id, last_edit_user_id, title, content, version, is_deleted) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{lastEditUserId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{version}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET content = #{content}, last_edit_user_id = #{lastEditUserId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM documents d INNER JOIN document_permissions dp ON d.id = dp.document_id WHERE dp.user_id = #{userId} AND dp.permission_level IN ('editor', 'viewer') AND dp.is_deleted = 0 AND d.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
